patch.value: GH-1598: bind batch mutation APIs to PmClient and expose canonical staged preview records

GitHub https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1598 requests native PmClient preview/commit methods bound to host root and author policy, plus canonical staged records for idempotent intent comparison. Current staged preview validation remains shipped; its result contains validation state, constraints and warnings rather than complete staged records.

Expose typed PmClient previewItemMutations and commitItemMutations forwarding bound root and author policy to the existing SDK coordinator; Return per-mutation canonical staged ids, normalized metadata and bodies with generated-value provenance and explicit commit-time constraints; Prove preview/read-back equivalence for unchanged admitted plans and safe identical-intent replay versus typed changed-intent conflicts using native non-Git fixtures; preserve read-only previews and current guarded commit behavior
Packages can perform host-bound atomic batches and compare normalized intents using SDK-owned records instead of re-deriving roots or duplicating normalization.
